description: This file contains multiple class definitions implementing Orleans grains and related interfaces, including test grains, internal grains, and utility grains with activation, deactivation, messaging, and context-related functionalities.

classes.name: TestGrain
classes.description: A test implementation of a Grain with key/value operations, timers, and context handling.

classes.name: TestGrainLongActivateAsync
classes.description: A variant of TestGrain with a longer activation delay for testing activation scenarios.

classes.name: GuidTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that uses GUID as primary key, implemented with a specific GrainType attribute.

classes.name: OneWayGrain
classes.description: A grain that demonstrates one-way messaging, observer pattern, and coordination among silos.

classes.name: CanBeOneWayGrain
classes.description: A simple grain that supports notification and exception throwing, demonstrating one-way operations.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles logic when the grain is activated, including key validation and initialization.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles logic when the grain is deactivated, including cleanup and logging.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the primary key of the grain.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Returns the label assigned to the grain.

methods.name: DoLongAction
methods.description: Performs a delayed action to simulate long processing.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets a new label for the grain and logs the operation.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Registers a timer that periodically calls TimerTick.

methods.name: TimerTick
methods.description: A timer callback that logs a tick event.

methods.name: TestRequestContext
methods.description: Sets and retrieves context data, verifying that RequestContext handles data correctly.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity ID.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the unique activation ID for the grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Provides a reference to the grain itself.

methods.name: GetMultipleGrainInterfaces_Array
methods.description: Returns multiple grain references as an array.

methods.name: GetMultipleGrainInterfaces_List
methods.description: Returns multiple grain references as a list.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync (GuidTestGrain)
methods.description: Activation logic for GUID-based grain, setting label and logging.

methods.name: GetKey (GuidTestGrain)
methods.description: Returns the primary key as a GUID.

methods.name: GetSiloAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the address of the silo hosting this grain.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Increments counter and notifies observer.

methods.name: Notify (with observer)
methods.description: Increments counter and informs the observer of state change.

methods.name: NotifyValueTask
methods.description: Same as Notify but returning a ValueTask.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrain
methods.description: Notifies another grain and checks if it completed synchronously.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrainValueTask
methods.description: Notifies another grain with ValueTask and checks completion status.

methods.name: GetOtherGrain
methods.description: Gets a reference to another grain possibly on another silo.

methods.name: GetActivationId (GuidTestGrain)
methods.description: Returns the activation ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetActivationAddress
methods.description: Returns the activation address for a given grain.

methods.name: StateChanged
methods.description: Callback for handling state change signals.

methods.name: SendSignalTo
methods.description: Sends a signal to another grain.

methods.name: SignalSelfViaOther
methods.description: Sends a signal to itself via another grain.

methods.name: WaitForSignal
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a signal to arrive.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Sets a signal value and completes a TaskCompletionSource.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Simple notification increases count.

methods.name: Notify (with observer)
methods.description: Notify observer and update count.

methods.name: NotifyValueTask
methods.description: Observer notification with ValueTask.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Returns current count of notifications.

methods.name: Throws
methods.description: Throws an exception for testing error handling.

methods.name: ThrowsValueTask
methods.description: Throws an exception wrapped in a ValueTask.
